land.text: the Marshall Islands District of the trust territory

predecessors.note: The page gives 'Self-government: May 1, 1979' (the US recognised the constitution) and 'Compact of Free Association: October 21, 1986'; the trust-territory dossier (this batch) keeps the land to 21 October 1986 and records the loss to republic-of-the-marshall-islands.

capitals.name: Majuro
capitals.note: 'The capital and largest city is Majuro, home to approximately half of the country's population'; infobox '7°7′N 171°4′E'.

correction.text: the Marshall Islands: the Ralik and Ratak atoll chains (Majuro, Kwajalein, Bikini, Enewetak) in free association with the United States

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row): the gazetteer's 'Marshall Is.' is cells: 2 (about 506 km2) (two cells around Majuro, infobox 7°7′N 171°4′E), against the page's 181.43 km2; the page names Kwajalein, Bikini and Enewetak, which this box does not cover, so the shape is smaller in extent than the state.

ledger.note: 1986: the Marshall Islands leave the trust territory: infobox 'Compact of Free Association: October 21, 1986'; 'The islands signed a Compact of Free Association with the United States in 1986.' The page gives self-government from 1 May 1979 and the end of the UN trusteeship by 'United Nations Security Council Resolution 683 of December 22, 1990'.

certainty.note: Atoll chains; borders are coasts (the state is 'in free association' with the United States, not part of it).

sources.title: Marshall Islands
sources.note: Self-government 1 May 1979, Compact of Free Association 21 October 1986, UN Resolution 683 (22 December 1990), area 181.43 km2, Majuro with coordinates, nuclear tests at Bikini and Enewetak 1946-1958, German protectorate 1885, Japanese mandate.

notes: Written by oc-02-x. One page opened (Marshall Islands). Start taken as the Compact of 21 October 1986 to match the trust-territory dossier, although the page also gives self-government from 1 May 1979; the UN trusteeship ended on 22 December 1990 (Resolution 683). Bikini and Enewetak: the page says 'the United States conducted 67 nuclear tests at Bikini Atoll and Enewetak Atoll' between 1946 and 1958. Kwajalein is 'the largest atoll with a land area of 6 square miles (16 km2)'. The German protectorate (29 August 1885) and the Japanese mandate belong to german-new-guinea (the protectorate was annexed to it in 1906) and south-seas-mandate (this batch). The country name gives only two cells near Majuro (bbox 171.12 to 171.64 E, 7.02 to 7.15 N); atolls beyond that box would need gazetteer place names, which the renderer or the gazetteer agent can add.
